title: Blogr.ai topical maps versus one-keyword-at-a-time SEO
summary: Serg introduces Blogr.ai topical maps built from live keyword data: hubs and subtopics with search volume, difficulty, intent, position, and opportunity scores, plus a free generator to try on your site.
question_it_answers: How does a topical map differ from chasing individual keywords in SEO tooling?

claims.text: Topical maps organize hubs and subtopics with internal links so pages do not cannibalize queries.
claims.evidence: two pages never fight for the same query, internal links are designed from the start
